_what: barstate.* read off a LIVE TradingView chart across the 2026-09-09 US open
_instrument: UCTPROBE_NS study on AMEX:SPY, plot VALUES read from the chart model
_why_values_not_pixels: A bool plot carries no numeric value, so every predicate is plotted as `? 1 : 0`. The capture reads study._data._items, never the screen.
_tab_was_hidden: document.visibilityState was 'hidden' for this whole capture and the panes rendered NOTHING (0 legend nodes, blank screenshot). The MODEL was unaffected: the study held 400 computed rows throughout. See docs/pine/capture-procedure.md — the hidden-tab defect is a RENDERING defect, and a value capture is immune to it.

captures.sessionState: pre-open, 32 minutes before the 09:30 ET open
captures._ruling: BEFORE THE SESSION OPENS THERE IS NO REALTIME BAR AT ALL. The newest bar is YESTERDAY's (2026-09-08) and it carries isconfirmed=1, islast=1 and ishistory=1 SIMULTANEOUSLY. So `islast` does not imply 'forming', and `ishistory` does not imply 'not the last bar' — a fold that treats either as the other's negation is wrong for the whole pre-open window, which is when a screener actually runs.
captures._note_no_bar_for_today: There is no 2026-09-09 bar at 08:58 ET. The daily bar is created at the open, which is what makes the 09:30 transition observable.

captures._ruling_the_transition: At the open the bar count goes 400 -> 401, a NEW bar is created for today, and TWO flags flip on it: isconfirmed 1 -> 0 and ishistory 1 -> 0. `islast` stays 1 and simply MOVES to the new bar.
captures._ruling_why_strict_mode_must_refuse_the_: ⛔⛔ THE SAME SCRIPT, THE SAME SYMBOL, THE SAME TIMEFRAME give DIFFERENT answers for barstate.isconfirmed and barstate.ishistory before and after 09:30 ET. A screener column that folded either to its closed-bar value pre-open would silently change meaning at the open, with nothing to refuse and nothing to point at. This is the measured justification for pine:live-bar-state in strict mode.
captures._ruling_forming_bar_signature: On the FORMING bar: isconfirmed=0, islast=1, ishistory=0. So for the newest bar, `ishistory` is the complement of 'this bar is still forming'. Note it is NOT the complement of `islast` — pre-open, islast=1 AND ishistory=1 on the same bar.
captures._note_still_unmeasured: isrealtime / isnew / islastconfirmedhistory are NOT in this capture. The existing UCTPROBE_NS plots only isconfirmed/islast/ishistory, and extending it needs a study added — blocked this visit by the hidden tab.

tickerid_shape._from: the same probe's N17-N20, same capture
tickerid_shape._reading: ticker='SPY' (3). tickerid is 8 = 4+1+3, consistent with 'AMEX:SPY' — an exchange prefix, a colon, then the ticker. The chart model independently reports the symbol string as 'AMEX:SPY'.
tickerid_shape._caveat: INFERRED, NOT ENUMERATED. This says what SPY's tickerid looks like; it does NOT enumerate what TradingView can emit. A bind-time fold over tickerid must be a whitelist of measured prefixes that REFUSES what it has not seen.

tickerid_shape_five_symbols._what: Volume line 222's OWN predicates, read across five instrument classes
tickerid_shape_five_symbols._how: The existing UCTPROBE_NS already plots exactly these (N17-N20). Only the SYMBOL was changed; no study was added. Chart restored to AMEX:SPY 1D.
tickerid_shape_five_symbols._prefix_derivation: prefix_len = tickerid_len - ticker_len - 1, which recovers AMEX(4), NASDAQ(6), FX(2), BITSTAMP(8), SP_DLY(6) exactly. The colon is confirmed present by the arithmetic closing on every row.
tickerid_shape_five_symbols._ruling_1_no_slash_anywhere: str.contains(...,'/') is FALSE on all five, INCLUDING forex (EURUSD) and crypto (BTCUSD). So on these feeds Volume line 222 folds to FALSE. ⛔ It does NOT follow that it is always false — other exchanges spell pairs with a separator. The fold must be a whitelist of measured feeds that REFUSES an unmeasured one, never a blanket false.
tickerid_shape_five_symbols._ruling_2_the_vendor_rewrites_the_prefix: ⛔⛔ THE TRAP. 'SP:SPX' was requested and the vendor resolved it to 'SP_DLY:SPX' — confirmed independently by tickerid_len=10 (6+1+3), not merely by the symbol string. So THE TICKERID IS NOT THE TEXT THE MEMBER TYPED. A bind-time fold keyed on an exchange prefix cannot use the requested prefix; it must use the RESOLVED one, which is only knowable at bind time. A whitelist doing exact-prefix comparison against 'SP' would miss; str.contains('SP') happens to still match inside 'SP_DLY' — which is worse, because it makes the wrong design look correct on this one example.
tickerid_shape_five_symbols._caveat: INFERRED, NOT ENUMERATED. Five symbols on five feeds. This says nothing about what other exchanges emit.

fold_pass_ruling_1g._what: Does the vendor accept a timeframe-conditional LENGTH — Volume line 233's shape?
fold_pass_ruling_1g._line233_shape: length = timeframe.isweekly ? 5 : 20, then used as a ta.* window

condition_half._measured: the existing probe's N05/N06/N07, chart resolution switched and restored
condition_half._ruling: The ternary's CONDITION flips exactly as expected on the vendor.

acceptance_half._instrument: Uncharted Volume ITSELF, already on the chart — the script that contains line 233
acceptance_half._ruling: ⭐⭐ THE VENDOR ACCEPTS AND RUNS IT. Uncharted Volume computes 400 rows on BOTH 1D and 1W with live values, and its outputs DIFFER between them. So a timeframe-conditional length is legal Pine — TradingView's own rule is that a length needs a 'simple int', which a bind-time ternary over two constants satisfies. Our pine:window refusal at line 233 is therefore a CAPABILITY GAP, not a correctness guard.
acceptance_half._why_this_beats_a_synthetic_probe: It is the actual line in question, in the member's own script, running on the vendor — not a reconstruction of it.

fold_pass_ruling_1g._still_unmeasured: ⛔ The NUMERIC half. That the vendor accepts the shape does NOT establish that the folded window is 5 on 1W and 20 on 1D. Proving the VALUE needs the three-SMA probe (fold vs sma20 vs sma5) from tools/visual_conformance/probes/fold-pass.pine, which requires ADDING a study — blocked this visit by the hidden tab. Until that is measured, the fold may be implemented but must not be assumed correct.
